scope: Twelve sentence-audited hard-masculine noun locative plurals in the base papers, across five exact source forms.
choice: Repair znakih, krokih, zaključkih, rezultatih and izrazih to the regular locative plural forms znakah, krokah, zaključkah, rezultatah and izrazah.
motivation: Each site is governed by v, pri or locative po and each head noun has a hard consonant stem; official first-declension morphology requires plural -ah rather than the inherited South-shaped -ih.
alternatives_rejected: A blanket *ih rule was rejected because adjective, pronoun, participle, soft-stem and numeral paradigms require separate treatment.
Retaining the five isolated noun forms would preserve noncanonical case morphology beside established -ah controls.
Changing other cases or foreign/comment/control material was rejected.

evidence.official_grammar: Official nouns.md lines 16, 27 and 29 gives consonant-final masculine first declension, defines the soft-stem set, and supplies plural case endings.
evidence.official_control: The official dictionary directly demonstrates hard masculine locative plural v metodah i principah.
evidence.edition_controls: Before the edit the source already had znakah 3, krokah 18, zaključkah 6 and izrazah 8.
evidence.protected_domains: No mapped token occurs in a comment, foreign argument or TeX control name.

validation.coverage: Exact source histogram: znakih seven, krokih two and one each zaključkih, rezultatih, izrazih; all in base.
validation.semantic_review: All 12 contexts are locative plural hard-stem nouns; no holds.
validation.postcondition: All five mapped source forms are zero and canonical targets total 47 across the five forms.
validation.structure: Byte count, line count, braces, ordered TeX controls and math delimiters are invariant; all other components are byte-identical.
validation.reproducibility: Frozen successor reproduced twice before atomic application and matched after application.
